helping dolphins. After some thought, I ⓐjoined it

plastic waste and fishing nets, so cleaning up
beaches is important. There was a beach ⓑcleanup
party today, and I took part in it. Cleaning up the
beach was not easy, but I enjoyed it. Oh, I saw
Aunt Sumi there. She is also a member of Dolphin
Lovers. What a small world!
FEB 14

Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in
Jeju-do. The ⓒlatest project of Dolphin Lovers is to
return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first
need to learn some skills. They will need them to
survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of
the project. Luckily, I got the ⓓchance. I just ran
some errands in the training class today, but the
experience made me so excited.

Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. There
was a small ⓔceremony, and all the members of
Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us
quite emotional. In fact, I cried a little. Now I
cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was

hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea is their
